title: LiveAccessRefusal
description:
⟨rev7⟩ The typed detail of a `CONFIG_CONFLICT` / `destination_has_live_access` refusal
(ADR-0013 D13). **Standalone, not attached** (U3 with U8b).

live.description: Up to [`LIVE_ACCESS_LISTED_MAX`] live or unresolved entries.

total.description: How many there are in all.

LiveAccessEntry.description: ⟨rev7⟩ One live or unresolved entry of a [`LiveAccessRefusal`].

remediation.description: `heimdall access stop --work <work_id>`, only for an entry with a work reference.

resource.description: The grant, binding or operation, by kind and opaque ID.

work_id.description: The work it belongs to, when it has an actual work reference.

ResourceRef.description: A reference to the resource an error concerns. Opaque IDs only; never a secret.

WorkId.description:
Caller-chosen work ID; a continuing binding cannot reset its expiry by
changing it (spec §6.1).
